title_pt: Argentina intercepta 721 peixes e invertebrados exóticos em Ezeiza
title_en: Argentina intercepts 721 exotic fish and invertebrates at Ezeiza
title_es: Argentina intercepta 721 peces e invertebrados exóticos en Ezeiza
source_label: Subsecretaría de Ambiente de la Nación
taxon_text: 102 espécies de peixes ornamentais e invertebrados marinhos; inclui peixe-leão
card_text_pt: Controles de carga no aeroporto de Ezeiza detectaram 33 caixas com 721 peixes ornamentais e invertebrados marinhos vivos sem as autorizações ambientais exigidas; a remessa procedia do Quênia.
card_text_en: Cargo controls at Ezeiza airport detected 33 boxes containing 721 live ornamental fish and marine invertebrates without the required environmental permits; the shipment came from Kenya.
card_text_es: Controles de carga en el aeropuerto de Ezeiza detectaron 33 cajas con 721 peces ornamentales e invertebrados marinos vivos sin las autorizaciones ambientales exigidas; el envío procedía de Kenia.

context_en: Documented facts: Cargo controls at Ezeiza airport detected 33 boxes containing 721 live ornamental fish and marine invertebrates without the required environmental permits; the shipment came from Kenya. Analytical context: Kenya → Ezeiza is the documented logistical origin of the shipment; this does not equal the biological origin of all 102 species. Evidence limits: The official source does not fix the exact detection day; `event_date` remains null.
